header:
Visible-Light Photocatalytic Reactions of Sulfonium Salts
On 2023-5-3, researchers from Qingdao University of Science and Technology published a study of visible-light photocatalytic reactions of sulfonium salts. Let the photosensitizer be denoted PC; in the photocatalytic pathway, light excites PC to PC*, which then participates in the reaction.

header_images.description: 'CC1=CC=C([S+]2CCCC2)C=C1.F[P-](F)(F)(F)(F)F' reacts with 'C=CC1=CC=CC=C1' under hv, Photocatalyst (mol%), Base (3.0 equiv), DMSO, N2, 24 h, r.t.

subquestions.text_open:
Standard conditions: The sulfonium salt shown reacts with styrene using PC7 (10 mol%) as the photosensitizer, $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ (3.0 equiv) as the base, and anhydrous DMSO as the solvent under irradiation with a 455 nm blue LED at room temperature for 24 hours.
10.2.2 Researchers added 1,1-diphenylethylene under the standard conditions to trap a reaction intermediate, giving a product containing 3 rings. Write the SMILES string of this 3-ring product.
10.2.3 Performing the reaction under the standard conditions but without DMSO gives a different product. Write its SMILES string.
10.3 Write the SMILES strings of the key intermediates and product of this reaction.
10.4 Treatment of the product from 10.3 with mCPBA (meta-chloroperoxybenzoic acid) gives two additional products. Write their SMILES strings.
